title: Google Ads for Moving Companies (7 Step Strategy)

facts.fact: Google Ads is a pay-per-click advertising suite covering Google Search, Maps, YouTube, Display, and Discovery, and advertisers only pay when someone clicks.
facts.quote: Because Google Ads are 'pay-per-click' ads, you only pay when someone clicks on your Google Ads to visit your website or book your services.

facts.fact: According to Ahrefs data cited by the vendor, the keyword 'moving company near me' had 900 UK monthly Google searches.
According to Ahrefs data cited by the vendor, the keyword 'moving company' had 1700 UK monthly Google searches.
According to Ahrefs data cited by the vendor, the estimated CPC for 'moving company london' was £8.00.

The vendor states that moving companies face a CPC ranging from £2-£3 for lower-end services like student moving.
facts.quote: Moving companies face a CPC that ranges from £2-£3 for lower-end services like student moving.

facts.fact: The vendor states that CPC increases to £16 per click for higher-value moves like offices and commercials.
